questions.question: At which ground did Asakhe Nyovane record their career-best innings (72, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at St George's Park, against Warriors on 2022/10/01.

questions.question: At which ground did Heat record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — largest win by runs of 375, against Dragons on 2011/03/12.

questions.question: Which of these teams has never finished in the top 3 (champion, runner-up, or 3rd place) across this database's 20-year history?
questions.explanation: Warriors are one of 8 unions never to have finished in the top 3, alongside Badgers, Heat, Limpopo Lillies, Rhinos, Tuskers, Eastern Storm and Kei.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Badgers or Titans?
How many sixes separate the all-time #1 (Tazmin Brits) and #2 (Anneke Bosch) six-hitters (combined T20 + List A) in the 22/23 season?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits: 26 — Anneke Bosch: 9 — a gap of 17.

questions.question: Susan Benade set a database record (T20) with a value of 43. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Matches as Captain', held by Susan Benade.
